name: Midnight Marrow Broth
steps: Char the onion and garlic in a dry cauldron until the edges blacken.
Add carrot, celery and potato with cold water to cover.
Simmer until the roots surrender, about 40 minutes.
Strain and serve the broth while it still whispers.
flavorText: A broth brewed at the witching hour, dark as a moonless bog.

name: Bubbling Cauldron Stew
steps: Sear the beef until it hisses.
Fold in onion and tomato and let them collapse.
Add potato and carrot, cover with stock, and let it bubble low for two hours.
flavorText: It bubbles on its own long after you stop stirring.

name: Spectral Scramble
steps: Melt butter until it foams like sea spray.
Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pour in.
Pull slowly off the heat while still glossy, then fold in cheese and chive.
flavorText: Pale, soft and gone before you know it, like a ghost at dawn.

name: Crimson Hex Soup
steps: Roast tomato, onion and garlic until blistered.
Blend to a smooth crimson pool.
Warm through with cream and a storm of torn basil.
flavorText: Red as a hex scrawled on a cottage door.

name: Wailing Widow Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in well-salted water until just firm.
Sizzle garlic and chili in olive oil until fragrant.
Crush in tomato, simmer briefly, then toss with the pasta.
flavorText: So fierce it makes the widow next door wail through the wall.

name: Goblin Garlic Bread
steps: Mash garlic and parsley into soft butter.
Slash the bread and pack the green butter into every wound.
Bake until the crust snaps and the kitchen smells haunted.
flavorText: Goblins would trade a sack of gold for a single slice.

name: Toadstool Risotto
steps: Soften onion in butter until see-through.
Toast the rice, then add stock one ladle at a time, stirring like a spell.
Fold in seared mushroom and cheese at the end.
flavorText: Earthy as a ring of toadstools after rain.

name: Black Cat Curry
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger to a dark paste.
Brown the chicken, add tomato and spices.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer until thick and glossy.
flavorText: Dark and lucky, like a cat crossing your path twice.

name: Enchanted Mash
steps: Boil potato until a fork slides through like a charm.
Warm milk with garlic and butter.
Mash together until clouds form.
flavorText: So smooth it seems bewitched.

name: Frog's Breath Frittata
steps: Soften onion and potato in a pan.
Wilt in spinach, pour over beaten egg and scatter cheese.
Finish under a grill until the top sets and puffs.
flavorText: Green-flecked and earthy, like the sigh of a contented frog.

name: Pumpkin Lantern Soup
steps: Roast pumpkin until the edges caramelize.
Sweat onion, garlic and ginger, then add the pumpkin and stock.
Blend smooth and swirl in cream.
flavorText: Glows orange in the bowl like a lantern on the porch.

name: Serpent Skin Tacos
steps: Brown beef with onion and chili.
Warm the tortillas until supple as shed skin.
Pile on the beef, fresh tomato and a drift of cheese.
flavorText: Rolled tight and scaled with melted cheese.

name: Witch's Garden Salad
steps: Tear lettuce into a wooden bowl.
Slice cucumber, tomato and onion thin as petals.
Dress with olive oil, salt and a squeeze of lemon.
flavorText: Picked at midnight from a garden that only grows under the moon.

name: Conjurer's Chili
steps: Brown beef with onion, garlic and chili.
Add tomato and bean with a little stock.
Simmer low until thick enough to stand a spoon in.
flavorText: Conjured to warm the bones of the whole coven.

name: Moon Milk Porridge
steps: Simmer oats in milk, stirring widdershins.
Sweeten with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Eat before the moon sets.
flavorText: Pale and calming, said to bring prophetic dreams.

name: Raven Wing Rice
steps: Fry cold rice hard until the grains leap.
Push aside, scramble egg, then fold everything together.
Season with soy sauce until it gleams black as a raven's wing.
flavorText: Glossy, dark and quick as a bird taking flight.

name: Hemlock Hummus (perfectly safe)
steps: Blend chickpea with garlic, tahini and lemon.
Loosen with cold water until silky.
Pool olive oil on top and swear it contains no hemlock.
flavorText: Named to scare the neighbours. It is only chickpeas.

name: Cobweb Carbonara
steps: Crisp the bacon until it shatters.
Toss hot pasta with beaten egg and cheese off the heat so it turns to silk, not scramble.
Fold in the bacon and a flood of black pepper.
flavorText: Strands cling together like old cobwebs in the rafters.

name: Shapeshifter Stir-Fry
steps: Sear chicken in a screaming-hot wok.
Throw in the vegetables and garlic and keep everything moving.
Splash with soy sauce and serve at once.
flavorText: Change the vegetables with the season; it becomes a different beast each time.

name: Banshee Banana Bread
steps: Mash the blackest bananas you can find.
Beat with butter, sugar and egg, then fold in flour.
Bake until a skewer comes out clean and the crust cracks like a scream.
flavorText: The darker the banana, the louder the banshee.

name: Swamp Pea Soup
steps: Sweat onion, add potato and stock, simmer until tender.
Add pea and mint and cook just two minutes to keep it green.
Blend to a swamp-coloured smoothness.
flavorText: Green and murky, but far friendlier than it looks.

name: Gravedigger's Gratin
steps: Layer thin potato slices in a dish rubbed with garlic.
Pour over cream and bury under cheese.
Bake slow until the top is a cracked, golden crust.
flavorText: Layered deep, like earth over a fresh grave.

name: Fairy Ring Flatbread
steps: Knead flour and yogurt into a soft dough.
Roll into rounds and blister in a dry pan.
Brush with garlic butter while hot.
flavorText: Round as a fairy ring; step inside at your own risk.

name: Nightshade Noodles (aubergine)
steps: Fry aubergine until collapsing and bronze.
Add garlic, chili and soy sauce to make a sticky glaze.
Toss through cooked noodles.
flavorText: Aubergine is a true nightshade, but a delicious one.

name: Coven Cornbread
steps: Whisk the dry together, then the wet, then marry them quickly.
Pour into a hot buttered pan.
Bake until golden and share around the circle.
flavorText: Baked in a cast-iron pan passed down through thirteen witches.

name: Elixir of Roots
steps: Toss all the roots with oil and roast until caramelized.
Simmer with stock, then blend to a thick elixir.
Season and serve steaming.
flavorText: Pulled from the cold ground to put warmth back in your chest.
